title: A museum of today
prompt: Choose one object you touched today. Photograph it and write the label you would want to read in ten years.

title: The usual, please
prompt: Catch a detail of a daily ritual, like the chipped edge of your mug. Finish the caption with what you would miss about it.

title: A song lives here
prompt: Think of a song that takes you back. Photograph an object that belongs in that scene and write who or what the song brings to mind.

title: Keep the first draft
prompt: Give something a first try on scrap paper. Save the crooked sketch, first line or pencil marks and name one thing you figured out.

title: Proof of a small win
prompt: Find a trace of something you can do now that once felt difficult. Take a picture and tell your past self what changed.

title: Today's signature color
prompt: Pick a color and look for it from where you are. Photograph the most surprising match and give today a paint-swatch name.

title: Our unofficial tradition
prompt: Ask what your group always seems to do together. Stage a photo of one detail and write how the tradition began, or your best guesses.

title: The joke in the group chat
prompt: Choose a phrase that makes everyone laugh. Photograph a prop that explains it and add the line a future friend would need to get the joke.

title: A recipe with a backstory
prompt: Trade stories of a meal someone made for you. Photograph a utensil or sketch one dish, then save the detail that makes it theirs.

title: Same minute, two stories
prompt: Pause together, in person or on a call. Each name the first detail you noticed. Photograph one and put both impressions in the caption.

title: Make a tiny trophy
prompt: Let someone volunteer a small win. Ask what it took, build a trophy from things at hand and photograph it with the winner's words.

title: Our debut album
prompt: Invent a band name for this group. Arrange three objects as the album cover and give the first track a title only your group would understand.

title: Postcard from right here
prompt: Frame a familiar spot as a postcard. Photograph a detail a visitor might miss and write a line to someone who would recognize it.

title: Picture the sound
prompt: Listen for a moment. Photograph what made one sound, or an object it reminds you of. Spell out the sound in the caption.

title: Before the day gets going
prompt: Find one sign of the morning where you are, even from your chair. Photograph it and write what the day still has in store.

title: The afternoon edition
prompt: Look for a detail that tells the story of this afternoon. Photograph it and turn the caption into a one-line local headline.

title: The last page of the day
prompt: Find one object that sums up the day so far. Photograph it where you are and write the closing line you want to remember.

title: A postcard for Crissy Field
prompt: Near the bay, look for a detail shaped by wind or water. Photograph it from where you are, or sketch a remembered view of Crissy Field.

title: Beside the Reflecting Pool
prompt: Look for a reflection near you, in glass, water or a spoon. Photograph it and write a postcard to the National Mall from your side of the reflection.

title: Cubbon Park in miniature
prompt: Look for a leaf shape or branching pattern nearby. Photograph it, or draw it from memory, and give your tiny piece of Bengaluru a name.

title: The unofficial postage stamp
prompt: Design a postage stamp for {place}. Photograph a detail or a little sketch for the stamp and tell the story behind your choice.

title: Directions only a local would give
prompt: Think of a landmark you use when describing {place} to someone. Photograph or sketch it, then write your directions in your own words.

title: Wish you were here
prompt: Pick a detail of life around {place} you would send to someone who moved away. Photograph it or draw it and write the first line of your postcard.
